concepts.title: Month calendar
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop application concept for the existing native AppKit macOS utility AI Usage Stats. This is an image exploration before implementation.
Primary request: a Home page, selected by default in the existing window, showing the known next quota reset dates for all connected Claude and Codex accounts in a calendar. Calendar events show a small provider icon immediately followed by the current remaining percentage, in the same compact style as a menu bar summary. Hovering an event opens a small native account-information popover anchored to that exact event.
Style: a precise front-facing macOS screenshot at approximately 1600 x 1000, with crisp SF Pro text, standard window traffic lights, native sidebar, thin separators, tight purposeful spacing, restrained native controls, no perspective. One app window fills the image; no desktop wallpaper or other apps.
Navigation: a 190-point-wide sidebar with Home selected, then four account rows: a Claude icon and Personal, a Claude icon and Studio, an OpenAI knot icon and Work, an OpenAI knot icon and Personal. Provider names beneath these aliases are allowed as account identification. Add Account and a gear control are native bottom actions. Window title AI Usage Stats. Show a small menu-bar strip above the window with compact monochrome Claude icon 18% and OpenAI knot icon 18%, matching the existing app. These aggregate percentages are independent of each calendar event.
Icons: Claude uses a recognizable small many-rayed asterisk/sunburst, Codex uses the recognizable OpenAI six-loop knot, not a robot, C letter, square, chat bubble, or random star. In calendar rows the icons are monochrome template icons and the percentages use tabular digits. Provider color is not needed.
Meaning: every displayed percent means REMAINING capacity, never used. Every event is a known next reset for a specific account and usage window, not a forecast. Show both 5-hour and weekly windows as separate events. Do not repeat assumed resets into later days. Calendar dates are quota resets, never billing renewal or credit expiry.
Use this identical fictional dataset for all explorations. Mock current time is Tuesday October 13, 2026, 10:00 AM CDT.
Claude Personal, personal@example.invalid, plan Max 20x: 5-hour 63% remaining resets October 13 at 12:00 PM CDT; weekly 39% remaining resets October 15 at 9:00 AM CDT.
Claude Studio, studio@example.invalid, plan Max 5x: 5-hour 82% remaining resets October 13 at 3:00 PM CDT; weekly 18% remaining resets October 17 at 2:00 PM CDT.
Codex Work, work@example.invalid, plan ChatGPT Pro: 5-hour 18% remaining resets October 13 at 11:00 AM CDT; weekly 71% remaining resets October 17 at 10:00 AM CDT.
Codex Personal, codex@example.invalid, plan ChatGPT Plus: 5-hour 92% remaining resets October 13 at 2:00 PM CDT; weekly 54% remaining resets October 19 at 9:00 AM CDT.
One functional hover popover must be visible. It is anchored to Claude Personal's 63% 5-hour event, pointer clearly over the event. Place the popover so it does not cover the triggering event or another populated date. Contents, verbatim, aligned in plain compact native text:
Claude
personal@example.invalid
Max 20x
5-hour                 63% remaining
Resets                 Today, 12:00 PM CDT
                       In 2 hours
Weekly                 39% remaining
Resets                 Thu, Oct 15, 9:00 AM CDT
Updated 10:00 AM CDT
A small footer below all main content says "Example accounts".
Keep monetary balances out of this reset calendar.
Constraints: information-dense, simple and readable, no dashboard statistic cards, no decorative pills, no colored event capsules, no graphs, no progress rings, no progress bars, no gradient backgrounds, no large welcome text, no faint gray section subtitles, no em dashes, no shiny glass marketing render, no animations, no invented provider data. This is an app screenshot, not a design presentation board. The small functional native hover popover may have rounded system corners and a subtle native shadow. Preserve generous enough calendar cell width for icon, percentage, and window label. Include a short "Remaining" meaning label in the toolbar or calendar header.
Layout A: familiar MONTH calendar, light appearance, white content and a lightly tinted macOS sidebar. Main content has a single toolbar: October 2026 on the left, native left/right chevrons, Today, a small native Month / Week segmented control with Month selected, and Refresh at the right. Home is selected in the sidebar.
The month grid takes almost all available main content. Seven columns labelled Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat, five rows, with accurate dates for October 2026. Row 1 Sep 27 28 29 30 and Oct 1 2 3. Row 2 Oct 4 through 10. Row 3 Oct 11 through 17. Row 4 Oct 18 through 24. Row 5 Oct 25 through 31. Previous-month dates are visually subdued. October 13 has a restrained native blue today marker at its date number.
Exactly eight event lines total: October 13 has, in chronological order, Codex icon 18% 5-hour, Claude icon 63% 5-hour (hovered), Codex icon 92% 5-hour, Claude icon 82% 5-hour. October 15 has Claude icon 39% Weekly. October 17 has Codex icon 71% Weekly then Claude icon 18% Weekly. October 19 has Codex icon 54% Weekly. All other dates are empty. Events are small plain text rows directly on the calendar, with no boxes and no repeated forecast events. No permanently visible details panel or upcoming-reset list. Native grid hairlines and unobtrusive dates. Place the one hover popover over an empty nearby region of the calendar.
